responsibility: Handler for BRIG variable directives across all storage segments. It builds GCC declarations for global, readonly, arg, and parameter variables; computes HSA-mandated size and alignment; manages special handling for kernarg, private, spill, and group storage via offset tables instead of direct objects; recognizes host-defined globals that require indirection; attaches initializers when present; and records function-scope variables for name mangling and later address resolution.
